This directory vendors browser bundles of:

- @lottiefiles/dotlottie-wc  v0.9.28  (dotlottie-wc.js)
- @lottiefiles/dotlottie-web v0.80.0  (dotlottie-player.wasm, the renderer bundled with dotlottie-wc)

Both are MIT-licensed. Full text below (identical for both packages).

To update: bump the version in package.json, `npm install`, then re-copy
node_modules/@lottiefiles/dotlottie-wc/dist/dotlottie-wc.js and
node_modules/@lottiefiles/dotlottie-web/dist/dotlottie-player.wasm into this
directory (see app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php for how they are
registered), and update the version numbers above.
